PostSummary: The debate flares up in quote-posts: one side posts assurance verses, the other posts warning verses, and each side accuses the other of distorting grace or denying it.
BiblicalResponse: Scripture holds both assurance and warning together, and flattening either side distorts the gospel. Believers can rest in Christ's finished work and in the Father's grip — and that very security produces perseverance, not presumption. If you are trusting Christ, you can have confidence; if you are coasting on a past prayer while walking away, that is the moment to return, not to argue.
